title: CHG-4503: change record for the timesheet service
body:
Decision

As recorded by the board, this change is declined. Recorded by Nadia Karim on 13 March 2025; the
board met on 5 October 2025 and the minutes are in the shared archive.

Summary

This memo records a change to the Timesheet Service that is currently rejected. It was raised by
Ivan Petrov of Platform Engineering and touches 27 hosts behind the Timesheet Service, all of them
in the production estate.

Details

The implementation plan, prepared with Bluegate Networks, covers these steps during the 22:00-23:30
UTC window:
* Rotate the database credentials used by the nightly batch jobs
* Raise the connection pool ceiling from 50 to 120 per node
* Move the nightly export to the new object store bucket
